title: Vehicle Service & Ownership Worksheets
subtitle: Print-friendly pages for organizing records and preparing practical conversations. Follow your owner's manual and qualified professional advice for vehicle-specific decisions.

pages.title: Vehicle handover card
pages.intro: Keep a compact reference for one vehicle. Avoid adding sensitive account or payment details.
fields: Notes about where records are filed

pages.title: Service and repair history
pages.intro: One line per visit. Separate work completed from recommendations or observations.

pages.title: Garage quote comparison
pages.intro: Ask for written, like-for-like estimates; this page does not determine whether a repair is necessary.

pages.title: Ownership-cost review
pages.intro: Choose one period and use consistent categories. Keep one-off expenses visible rather than hiding them in an average.

pages.title: Documents and next questions
pages.intro: Use this index as a pointer to safely stored files, not as a place for passwords or full financial account details.
